detected_fault: Visual glitches and purple lines on the TV
Constant ring next to the mouse cursor as if the computer is loading or thinking
Fans blowing at max speed even when not under heavy load
Battery life issue after unplugging from external display
suggested_solution: Contact Dell support for further assistance and potential repair or replacement of the motherboard
Try plugging the HDMI cable into a different port on the TV to rule out port issues
Close the laptop lid properly to avoid affecting cooling and wireless connectivity
Consider upgrading to an HDMI 2.1 cable
